title: tgcloud project config
description: Project-level configuration for the tgcloud CLI (tgcloud.jsonc, or a strict-JSON tgcloud.json, at the project root).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support: "./node_modules/@tgcloud/cli/schema/tgcloud.json".

static.description: The mini app's static build: a folder name ("dist"), a full block, or false to remove the deployed static on the next push. Omit the key when this project does not manage static.

oneOf.description: Build output folder, relative to the project root (e.g. "dist"). Same as { "source": "dist" }.
Remove the deployed static site on the next push.

pathPattern.description: Starts with "/": an exact path ("/index.html") or a prefix ending in "/*" ("/assets/*"). "/*" matches everything. No other wildcards.

source.description: Build output folder, relative to the project root (e.g. "dist"). The only client-side key; everything else is the serving config and is validated by the server.

spa.description: Serve index.html for extension-less paths that do not exist (client-side routing). Paths with an extension still 404.

immutable.description: Patterns whose files are cached by browsers for a year (Cache-Control: max-age=31536000, immutable). Only for content-hashed files ("/assets/*"); a pattern matching an .html file is rejected.

headers.description: Response header rules, applied in order; a later rule replaces an earlier header of the same name. null removes a header, including a platform default (e.g. "X-Robots-Tag": null).

set.description: Header name → value, or null to remove. Not settable: Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Encoding, ETag, Last-Modified, Vary, Set-Cookie, Location, X-Content-Type-Options and other transport headers.

redirects.description: Redirect rules, first match wins. An existing file always beats a rule. Redirects only — no rewrites, no proxying.

to.description: An absolute path ("/new") or an absolute https:// URL. No substitutions: a prefix rule leads to one fixed target.
